cases.name: single equality with covering columns
cases.query: SELECT Id, Total FROM Orders WHERE CustomerId = @c

cases.name: equality before range
cases.query: SELECT Id, Total FROM Orders WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND CustomerId = 5

cases.name: only first range column is a key, the rest go to include
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'Open' AND OrderDate > @d AND Total > 100

cases.name: order by extends the key when there is no range
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE CustomerId = 1 ORDER BY OrderDate DESC

cases.name: order by after a range goes to include
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE CustomerId = 1 AND OrderDate > @d ORDER BY Total

cases.name: group by follows equality
cases.query: SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(*) FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'Paid' GROUP BY CustomerId

cases.name: join: filter equality leads, join column follows
cases.query: SELECT o.Id, c.Name FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.Id = o.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'ID'

cases.name: IN list counts as equality
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE OrderDate > @d AND Status IN ('A', 'B')

cases.name: OR on the same column behaves like IN
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'A' OR Status = 'B'

cases.name: OR across columns is not seekable
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'A' OR CustomerId = 3

cases.name: function on column is non-sargable
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2024

cases.name: leading wildcard is non-sargable, prefix LIKE is a range
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Customers WHERE Name LIKE '%son' AND Country LIKE 'I%'

cases.name: SELECT * disables covering
cases.query: SELECT * FROM Orders WHERE CustomerId = 1

cases.name: correlated EXISTS subquery
cases.query: SELECT c.Name FROM Customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Orders o WHERE o.CustomerId = c.Id AND o.Status = 'Open')

cases.name: UPDATE gets seek keys only
cases.query: UPDATE Orders SET Status = 'Closed' WHERE CustomerId = 3 AND OrderDate < @d

cases.name: DELETE with alias
cases.query: DELETE o FROM Orders o WHERE o.Status = 'Draft'

cases.name: CTE names are not tables
cases.query: WITH x AS (SELECT CustomerId FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'A') SELECT CustomerId FROM x WHERE CustomerId = 1

cases.name: left-prefix proposals on one table are consolidated
cases.query: SELECT Id FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'A'; SELECT Total FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'A' AND OrderDate > @d;

cases.name: schema resolves unqualified columns across a join
cases.query: SELECT Name FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.Id = o.CustomerId WHERE Country = 'ID'

cases.name: no schema: ambiguous unqualified column is skipped
cases.query: SELECT o.Id FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.Id = o.CustomerId WHERE Country = 'ID'

cases.name: existing index fully covers the proposal
cases.query: SELECT Total FROM Orders WHERE CustomerId = 1

cases.name: existing index covers the key but not the include
cases.query: SELECT Total FROM Orders WHERE Status = 'Open'

cases.name: clustered primary key covers lookups by id
cases.query: SELECT Name, Country FROM Customers WHERE Id = 5

cases.name: primary key columns are not repeated in include
cases.query: SELECT Id, Total FROM Orders WHERE OrderDate > @d
